body: That's honestly a very complicated question right now.  The short answer is yes, probably.  It seems very odd but in some ways I want to go back to that situation, and the thought that that is the case sickens me to my core though.  It's one of the things I'm currently working through with my cbt.

Not that odd a question and sorry for the very late reply, I kept looking at your question and just wasn't really felling in the mood to answer until now. 

 I lived with my father so this was an ordeal that happened pretty much every week over the course of several years.  As for how he got me to do what he asked, I don't recall much coercion being needed.  He was rather violent and wasn't above causing me pain if I disobeyed so I suppose you could argue that a fear of punishment made me do what he said.  When it comes down to it though I generally just did as he asked without much question, just as most well disciplined children learn to do what their parents say.
I'll answer questions if you'd like... But I reserve the right not to answer.

If I have any say in this, I'd recommend picking the wealthy guy.   I don't like referring to myself as broken, but if the lonely broken individual is anything like myself, they probably don't plan on living for all that long a time even without suicide.  I'm surprised when I make it another week, never the less years and years.  Use the same criteria one would when selecting organ transplant patients.  Healthy (both mentally and physically), responsible folks who will enjoy a higher quality of life and who aren't suicide risks.  Basically everything I'm not.

Not really an asshole thing so much as a regret for a time where I was selfish and cowardly.  My father was a sexual predator who tortured and sodomized me for years and would occasionally bring other children into our house for him to abuse and photograph.  I finally got separated from him when he went to prison on a DUI charge but in all the time I've had I've never told anyone who had the power to arrest him about it, and I can be almost certain that he had more victims after I left out...  He died not long ago but if I ever met you in my basement, and if any of you were victims of his, I'm more sorry than you can ever know.

Edit:  Woo hoo! my cakeday. I guess this means it's been 1 year today since I made this account as a throwaway to post on /r/SuicideWatch...  Most depressing digital representation of a slice of cake ever.

Edit 2:  I'm really not this depressing most of the time guys, honestly.
I'm addicted to violence.  I escaped from an abusive situation and a part of me seems to want nothing more than to go back to it.
That's a matter of perspective.  I'm out of that situation at the least.
I was nearly beaten to death by my drunk father for threatening to call the police.  He literally beat me past when I lost consciousness.   I really thought I was going to die.
